questions.question: Although he is rich, he is an honest man. This is a – [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
multiple sentence

questions.question: What kind of sentence is – “Fight till you die”? [SABAS][]
options: Simple
Complex
Compound
Complex- Compound
questions.explanation: till' বা 'until' যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করলে তা Complex sentence হয়.

questions.question: If it rains, the match will be postponed. The type of sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: simple
negative
complex
compound
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional বাক্যটি একটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: He is poor but honest
There is no mother but loves her child.
Do or die
He tried hard to help me.
questions.explanation: এখানে 'but' relative pronoun হিসেবে কাজ করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: There is no mother but loves her children. The sentence is - [SABAS][]
options: simple
complex
compound
complex-compound
questions.explanation: এই বাক্যে 'but' একটি relative pronoun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে, যা subordinate clause গঠন করে.

questions.question: Which one of the following is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Only the graduates need apply.
He is better than any other boy in the class.
We eat that we may live.
We saw him writing a letter.
questions.explanation: that' conjunction ব্যবহার করে subordinate clause গঠন করা হয়েছে, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Do whatever you like. This is an example of - [SABAS][]
options: Simple sentence
Compound sentence
Complex sentence
Multiple sentence
questions.explanation: whatever' দ্বারা subordinate clause গঠন করা হয়েছে, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one of the followings is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Some students like to study in the morning.
I hate running, but like walking.
They are studying because they have a test in the afternoon.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.
questions.explanation: because' conjunction যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Despite his poverty, he is honest.
Having reached in London, he will attend a conference
He is poor but honest.
The man who came here this morning is my brother.
questions.explanation: who' দ্বারা গঠিত clause-টি subordinate clause, তাই এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Though Rajib is ill, he regularly attends classes.
Despite his illness, he regularly attends classes.
Inspite his illness, he regularly attends classes.
Rajib is ill, but regularly attends classes.
questions.explanation: Though' যুক্ত হয়ে subordinate clause গঠন করায় এটি Complex sentence.

questions.question: A compound sentence has --- [SABAS][]
options: A subject and a finite verb
One principal clause and one sub-ordinate clause
Two or more co-ordinate clauses
Two or more sub-ordinate clauses
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ দুই বা ততোধিক Principal clause থাকে, যা Co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়।

questions.question: A compound sentence must have --- principal clause. [SABAS][]
options: More than one
Three
Four
None
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এর মৌলিক বৈশিষ্ট্য হলো এতে অন্তত দুটি Principal clause থাকতে হয়।

questions.question: Identify the compound sentence: [SABAS][]
options: If you read you will learn
Turning to the left you will see the shop
I shall work or I shall fail
Had I the wings of a bird
questions.explanation: I shall work' এবং 'I shall fail' দুটি Principal clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: ‘Do or die’ is a – [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
conditional sentence
questions.explanation: এখানে দুটি Imperative clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে Compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: Which one is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: As I am weak I cannot walk.
Owing to weakness I cannot walk.
I am weak but I can walk.
I can walk although I am weak.
questions.explanation: এখানে 'I am weak' ও 'I can walk' দুটি Principal clause 'but' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: We must not be late, else we will miss the train.' This is a- [SABAS][]
options: compound sentence
complex sentence
simple sentence
interrogative sentence
questions.explanation: else' দ্বারা দুটি Principal clause যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: He is weak but is a hard worker.
In spite of being weak, he works hard.
He is weak but hard worker.
Though he is weak, he works hard.
questions.explanation: In spite of being weak' একটি phrase এবং একটি Finite verb থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Let them do or they will die.
If he helps us we will win.
Move or you will die.
Work hard or you can't prosper in life.
questions.explanation: If' দ্বারা subordinate clause গঠিত হওয়ায় এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘Do or die’ is a/an – sentence. [SABAS][]
options: simple
complex
compund
interrogative
questions.explanation: এটি একটি Compound sentence, যেখানে দুটি Imperative clause 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: What type of sentence ‘Work or you will fail’ is? [SABAS][]
options: a complex sentence
a compound sentence
an optative sentence
a simple sentence
questions.explanation: or' conjunction ব্যবহার করে দুটি স্বাধীন বাক্য যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: Jumping up he ran away' This sentence is – [SABAS][]
options: simple
compound
complex
gerund
questions.explanation: Jumping up' একটি participle phrase এবং বাক্যে একটিমাত্র finite verb (ran) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: All the following sentences are compound except- [SABAS][]
options: He was ill, therefore, he could not come.
Speak the truth and I shall pardon you.
He must return the goods or pay the bill.
I offended him as did this.
questions.explanation: I offended him as did this' বাক্যটিতে একটি principal clause ও একটি subordinate clause থাকায় এটি Complex sentence, Compound নয়।

questions.question: Learn English and get a good job. It is a/an -- [SABAS][]
options: Complex sentence
Simple sentence
Compound sentence
Exclamatory sentence
questions.explanation: দুটি imperative clause 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি একটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: ‘There is nothing nobler than love’ is a/an- [SABAS][]
options: assertive sentence
simple sentence
compound sentence
complex sentence
questions.explanation: এটিতে 'than' conjunction-এর ব্যবহার পরোক্ষভাবে একটি subordinate clause নির্দেশ করে, তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: If you read, you will learn. This sentence is a – [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
negative sentence
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional বাক্য সর্বদা Complex sentence হয়।

questions.question: ‘One day the sailors saw an albatross flying towards the ship’. It is an example of a- [SABAS][]
options: Complex sentence
Compound sentence
Simple sentence
None of them
questions.explanation: বাক্যটিতে একটিমাত্র subject এবং একটিমাত্র finite verb (saw) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: Identify the complex sentence. [SABAS][]
options: He confessed his crime.
The management is thoroughly bad.
He finished his exercise and put away his books.
He bought the library which belonged to his uncle.
questions.explanation: which belonged to his uncle' একটি adjective clause (subordinate), তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘A hundred percent marks in English is too high to achieve.’ is a – sentence. [SABAS][]
options: Simple
Complex
Incorrect
Compound
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র clause এবং finite verb (is) থাকায় এটি একটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘He had many acquaintances but few really close friends. This is the example of- [SABAS][]
options: Compound sentence
Complex sentence
Simple sentence
Contracted sentence
questions.explanation: but' দ্বারা যুক্ত দুটি অংশ একটি Compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: This is the act of a wise man.
This is an act and a wise man does it.
This act is done by a wise man.
This is the act that a wise man does.
questions.explanation: that a wise man does' অংশটি adjective clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করে।

questions.question: ‘I know who he is.’ This is an example of —. [SABAS][]
options: compound sentence
complex sentence
simple sentence
conditional sentence
questions.explanation: who he is' একটি noun clause, যা principal clause-এর object হিসেবে কাজ করছে, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: All that glitters is not gold. This sentence is – [SABAS][]
options: simple
complex
compound
complex-compound
questions.explanation: that glitters' একটি subordinate adjective clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Seeing the police the thief ran away
The thief saw the police while he ran away
When the thief saw the police, he ran away
The thief saw the police and ran away
questions.explanation: দুটি প্রধান খণ্ডবাক্য (The thief saw the police ও ran away) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে, তাই এটি compound।

questions.question: The South Pole is too cold for human beings to live in. It is a : [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
multiple sentence
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (is) এবং একটি clause থাকায় এটি simple sentence।

questions.question: Which is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Tell me what you mean by this.
He always does not speak as he thinks.
If I make a promise, I keep it.
The machine is working beyond our expectation.
questions.explanation: এতে কোনো subordinate clause নেই এবং একটিমাত্র finite verb (is working) রয়েছে, তাই এটি simple sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a complex sentence? [SABAS][]
options: The water being very hot, I couldn't drink
Since the water was very hot, I couldn't drink it.
Being poor, I couldn't buy a chain
Because of his playing well, he won the game
questions.explanation: Since' যুক্ত অংশটি একটি subordinate clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: ‘Though he was very rich, he was still very unhappy’ is a — [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
conditional sentence
questions.explanation: Though' যুক্ত খণ্ডবাক্যটি subordinate, যা complex sentence নির্দেশ করে।

questions.question: He looked all around and disappeared. The type of this sentence is — [SABAS][]
options: simple
compound
complex
negative
questions.explanation: দুটি সমজাতীয় অংশ (looked, disappeared) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: The sentence “He ate rice and came to school” is — [SABAS][]
options: Simple
Complex
Compound
None
questions.explanation: এতে দুটি সমজাতীয় খণ্ডবাক্য 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়ে compound sentence গঠন করেছে।

questions.question: “She spoke very strongly and you listened to her.” It is an example of--- [SABAS][]
options: a complex sentence
a compound sentence
simple sentence
Both simple and complex sentence
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন বাক্য (principal clauses) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: ‘Killing the bird, the old man brought bad luck to the crew’ is a - [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
none of them
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (brought) এবং একটিমাত্র subject (the old man) থাকায় এটি একটি simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘Without working hard, you will not prosper in life’ is a- [SABAS][]
options: conditional sentence
compound sentence
complex sentence
simple sentence
questions.explanation: এটি একটি simple sentence, কারণ এতে একটিমাত্র clause এবং finite verb (will prosper) আছে।

questions.question: ‘I saw a boy who was poor’ is a- [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
compound sentence
complex sentence
none of them
questions.explanation: who was poor' একটি subordinate adjective clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one of the following is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Turning to the left you will see the shop.
If you read you will learn.
I shall work hard or I shall fail.
Had I the wings of a bird?
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন খণ্ডবাক্য (I shall work hard, I shall fail) 'or' conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে, তাই এটি compound sentence।

questions.question: “You should apologize for what you have done” is a - [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
simple sentence
compound sentence
adverbial clause
questions.explanation: what you have done' একটি noun clause (subordinate), তাই পুরো বাক্যটি একটি complex sentence।

questions.question: The girl who sat next to me is an architect. It is a: [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
complex-compound sentence
questions.explanation: who sat next to me' একটি adjective clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করে।

questions.question: A complex sentence is one which contains [SABAS][]
options: one independent clause and one subordinate clause
two subordinate clause
two independent clauses
neither of the above
questions.explanation: একটি complex sentence-এ কমপক্ষে একটি independent clause এবং একটি subordinate clause থাকে।

questions.question: He is a boy who has his merit. This sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: exclamatory
compound
complex
simple
questions.explanation: who has his merit' একটি subordinate clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Work hard and you will succeed
Work hard for success
If you work hard, you will succeed
You need to be hard working to succeed
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন খণ্ডবাক্য (independent clauses) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি একটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: ‘If we don't read we become trapped in our own individual minds’ is a -. [SABAS][]
options: a simple sentence
an imperative sentence
a complex sentence
an exclamatory sentence
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional clause থাকায় এটি একটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: If I make a promise I keep it
You can talk as much as you like
While there is life there is hope
He will pay only under compulsion
questions.explanation: বাক্যটিতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (will pay) আছে এবং কোনো subordinate clause নেই, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: You must work for success. (Make it compound without changing meaning) [SABAS][]
options: Work hard for the success.
Work hard for success.
Work hard to succeed.
Work hard and you will succeed.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ দুটি clause থাকে যা 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত, এখানে 'Work hard' ও 'you will succeed' যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Because of illness, he could not attend the meeting. This is a ---- [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
multiple sentence
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (could not attend) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘I saw that the boy was playing.’ It is an example of a – [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
exclamatory sentence
questions.explanation: that the boy was playing' একটি noun clause, তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘Besides robbing the poor child, he also murdered her’– this sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: a compound sentence
a simple sentence
a complex sentence
an optative sentence
questions.explanation: Besides robbing' একটি phrase, এবং বাক্যে একটি finite verb (murdered) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: The tiger having fallen, he climbed down from the tree. [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
simple sentence
compound sentence
negative sentence
questions.explanation: The tiger having fallen' একটি absolute phrase এবং বাক্যে একটি finite verb (climbed) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: What is the sentence-pattern of the following sentence? ‘Besides making a promise, he kept it.’ [SABAS][]
options: Complex sentence
Compound sentence
Simple sentence
Negative sentence
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র clause (he kept it) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘There is no meaning in what you say’ what type of sentence is it? [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
compound sentence
positive sentence
complex sentence
questions.explanation: what you say' একটি noun clause, যা Complex sentence নির্দেশ করে।

questions.question: Since the water was hot, I could not drink it. (The correct simple sentence of the above complex sentence is -) [SABAS][]
options: The water was very hot, so I could not drink it.
The water being very hot, I could not drink it.
As the water being very hot, I could not drink it.
I could not drink the water because it was hot.

questions.question: He shut the door and went out. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: Shutting the door, he went out.
He shutting the door before went out.
He went out shutting door.
Closing the door he went out.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ 'and' থাকলে Simple-এ প্রথম verb-এর সাথে -ing যোগ করতে হয়।

questions.question: The man said this and went away. (Complex) [SABAS][]
options: Saying this the man went away
Having said this the man went away
The man went away after he had said this
None of the above
questions.explanation: Simple sentence-কে Complex-এ রূপান্তরের সময় and তুলে দিয়ে দুটি clause করতে হয়।

questions.question: I had done the work and went home (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: Having done the work, I went home
Being done the work, I went home
Because of being done the work, I went home
As I had done the work, I went home
questions.explanation: কাজ শেষ বোঝাতে Having + past participle ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Though he is poor, he is happy. (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: Despite his poverty, he is happy.
In spite of his being poor, he is unhappy.
He is poor but happy.
In spite of his poorness, he is happy.
questions.explanation: Though/Although যুক্ত Complex sentence-কে Simple করতে 'Despite/In spite of' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Though he tried hard, he failed. (Compound) [SABAS][]
options: He tried and failed
In spite of his trying hard, he failed.
He tried hard but failed
But for his trying hard, he failed.
questions.explanation: Though যুক্ত বাক্যকে Compound করার সময় 'but' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: Find the complex form of 'He is poor but honest'. [SABAS][]
options: Although he is poor he is honest
He being poor is honest
Despite his poverty he is honest
In spite his honesty he is poor
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ but থাকলে Complex করার সময় Although/Though যোগ করতে হয়।

questions.question: Ten years have passed since his father died. Make it simple: [SABAS][]
options: His father died since ten years.
His father has died ten years ago.
His father died ten years ago.
His father has died for ten years.
questions.explanation: Since যুক্ত বাক্যের সময়বাচক অংশকে Simple করার সময় past indefinite tense ও 'ago' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: I know him. Correct complex sentence of this sentence is: [SABAS][]
options: I know who was he.
I know who he is.
Who is he I know.
I know what is he.
questions.explanation: Noun clause-কে Complex করার সময় 'wh-word + subject + verb' গঠন ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Without doing you will die. The compound form of the sentence- [SABAS][]
options: Do and then die
Either do or die
Do or you will die
Do or die
questions.explanation: Without + gerund যুক্ত Simple sentence-কে Compound করার জন্য 'or' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: When we woke up, it was raining. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: At the time of his waking it was raining
He woke up and it was raining
He was wokeing up and it was raining
He was woke up and at the same time it was raining.
questions.explanation: When যুক্ত clause-কে Simple করার সময় 'At the time of + possessive + gerund' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Choose the correct complex form of the sentence: Weather permitting, the match will be held tomorrow afternoon. [SABAS][]
options: As weather permits, the match will be held tomorrow afternoon.
Because weather permits, the match will be held tomorrow afternoon.
If weather permitted, the match would be held tomorrow afternoon.
If weather permits, the match will be held tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explanation: Participial phrase 'Weather permitting' কে Complex করার সময় 'If + subject + verb' (conditional clause) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: The complex form of “They cried out at the top of their voice” is — [SABAS][]
options: They cried out so loudly that their voice weakened
They cried out as highly as they expected
They cried out as loudly as they could
They cried out as loudly as was possible
questions.explanation: Phrase 'at the top of their voice' কে Complex করার সময় 'as loudly as they could' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: ‘You must work hard to succeed’ (into compound one) [SABAS][]
options: If you work hard you will not fail.
You must work hard not for failing.
You must work hard to avoid failing.
You must work hard or you will fail.
questions.explanation: Simple sentence-এ 'to succeed' যুক্ত থাকলে Compound করার সময় 'or' (শর্ত) ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: ‘I do not know the cause of his silence.’ Make it complex. [SABAS][]
options: I do not know why he is silent.
I do not know why he was silent.
I know nothing why he is silent.
none
questions.explanation: Noun phrase 'the cause of his silence' কে Complex করার সময় 'why + subject + verb' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: ‘His silence proves that he is guilty.’ Its simple form is. [SABAS][]
options: His silent proves his guiltiness.
His silence proves his guilt.
He is silent because he is guilty.
His silence shows him guilty
questions.explanation: Noun clause 'that he is guilty' কে Simple করার সময় 'his + noun' (guilt) গঠন ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: The correct simple sentence is -‘Although he spoke clumsily, I listened to him very carefully. [SABAS][]
options: Though his speech was clumsy, I listened to him carefully.
Despite the clumsiness of his speech, I listened to him carefully.
He spoke clumsily, then I listened to him carefully.
Despite speaking clumsy manner, I listened to him carefully.
questions.explanation: Although যুক্ত বাক্যকে Simple করার সময় 'Despite + noun phrase' (the clumsiness of his speech) গঠন ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: ‘I will kill you if you don’t speak the truth’. Compound form of the sentence is: [SABAS][]
options: Speak the truth or I will kill you.
I will kill you, if you do not speak the truth.
I will not kill you if you speak the truth.
Speak the truth, then I will not kill you.
questions.explanation: Conditional sentence-কে Compound করতে 'Imperative + or' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: ‘The boy was diligent, so the teacher praised him’. The simple form of this sentence is: [SABAS][]
options: The boy was diligence as the teacher praised him.
The teacher praised the boy for his diligent.
The teacher praised the boy for his diligence.
The boy was praised by the teacher for his diligence.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এর কারণবাচক অংশকে Simple করার সময় 'for + noun' (diligence) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Which one is the correct sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Although he is poor, he is honest.
Although he is poor, so he is honest.
Although he is poor, but he is honest.
Although he is poor and he is honest
questions.explanation: Although যুক্ত বাক্যে 'but' বা 'so' বসে না; শুধুমাত্র কমা (,) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: What is the simple form of the sentence? 'It is certain that he will come'? [SABAS][]
options: He will certainly come
Surely he will come
His coming is more than certain.
There is a certainty in his coming.
questions.explanation: Noun clause-কে Simple করার সময় Adverb (certainly) ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: You should not be a borrower or lender. (Make it compound without changing meaning) [SABAS][]
options: Do not be a borrower and a lender.
Never be a borrower and a lender.
Neither a borrower nor a lender be.
Do not borrow and lent.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ 'or' বা 'nor' ব্যবহার করে নেতিবাচক অর্থ প্রকাশ করা হয়।
